name: bld5_nilpotent_pow_rank_succ_eq_zero
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A) : A ^ (A.rank + 1) = 0
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A), A ^ (A.rank + 1) = 0
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_rank_pow_convex, Mathlib2.gen_lin_nilpotent_pow_card_reduced, Mathlib2.bld4_rank_pow_eq_of_card_le and Mathlib2.lib_matrix_rank_eq_zero_iff (nilpotency index ≤ rank + 1): let r_k = rank(A^k). If r_{k+1} = r_k for some k then by bld2_rank_pow_convex (non-increasing non-negative drops) r_j = r_k for all j ≥ k, and by gen_lin_nilpotent_pow_card_reduced / bld4_rank_pow_eq_of_card_le r_j = 0 for large j, so r_k = 0. Hence r_k strictly decreases until it reaches 0, so r_{k+1} ≤ r_1 − k while positive; thus r_{r_1 + 1} = 0 and lib_matrix_rank_eq_zero_iff gives A^(rank A + 1) = 0.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), IsNilpotent A → A ^ (A.rank + 1) = 0
